title: [epic] Prometheus metrics — operational observability
description:
Why: Production deployments need visibility into article ingest rate, pipeline latency, IPFS block write/read throughput, peer connection counts, queue depths, and error rates. Prometheus is the standard for this in the Rust/cloud ecosystem; the metrics-rs / prometheus crates are mature.

What:
- Add a GET /metrics endpoint to the admin HTTP server (already exists) returning Prometheus text exposition format.
- Metrics to expose:
    Counters: articles_ingested_total, articles_rejected_total (by reason), pipeline_errors_total, ipfs_writes_total, ipfs_reads_total, ipfs_cache_hits_total, ipfs_cache_misses_total
    Gauges: ingestion_queue_depth, staging_queue_depth (if write-ahead buffer enabled), peer_connections_active, groups_total, articles_total
    Histograms: pipeline_duration_seconds, ipfs_write_duration_seconds, ipfs_read_duration_seconds, nntp_command_duration_seconds
- Metrics endpoint is protected by the same bearer token as other admin endpoints.
- Use the metrics crate (facade) so the implementation can be swapped; default to prometheus-client.
- Apply to transit, reader, mail, and smtp binaries.
